name: 33149 · Key Biscayne, FL
findings: ZIP 33149 (Key Biscayne) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33149 (Key Biscayne) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33149 (Key Biscayne) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
